dossier_meta.catalog_title: Informal Conjecture: min degree $\geq 6$, max degree $\leq 8$ forces $K_6$ minor
dossier_meta.statement_text: Every non-null graph with minimum degree at least six and maximum degree at most eight has a $K_6$ minor.
dossier_meta.context_text: Stated parenthetically immediately after Conjecture 1.3: ``Indeed, as far as we know, every non-null graph with minimum degree at least six and maximum degree at most eight has a $K_6$ minor.'' It is a stronger open belief than Conjecture 1.3.
